generatedCommentsNodes.comment:
The JSON example in the documentation contains trailing commas, making it invalid JSON:
```json
"aliases": [ "logs-non-existing" ],
```
This appears in both the `remove` and `add` action objects. Users who copy-paste this example will get a parse error. Remove the trailing commas after the `aliases` arrays.

@@ -121,6 +121,77 @@ POST _aliases
 // TEST[s/^/PUT _data_stream\/logs-nginx.access-prod\nPUT _data_stream\/logs-my_app-default\n/]
 // end::alias-multiple-actions-example[]
 
+[discrete]
+[[multiple-action-results]]
+=== Multiple action results
+
+When using multiple actions, if some succeed and some fail, a list of per-action results will be returned.
+
+Consider a similar action list to the previous example, but now with an alias `log-non-existing`, which does not yet exist.
+In this case, the `remove` action will fail, but the `add` action will succeed.
+The response will contain the list `action_results`, with a result for every requested action.
+
+[source,console]
+----
+POST _aliases
+{
+  "actions": [
+    {
+      "remove": {
+        "index": "index1",
+        "alias": "logs-non-existing"
+      }
+    },
+    {
+      "add": {
+        "index": "index2",
+        "alias": "logs-non-existing"
+      }
+    }
+  ]
+}
+----
+// TEST[s/^/PUT \/index1\nPUT \/index2\n/]
+
+The API returns the following result:
+
+[source,console-result]
+--------------------------------------------------
+{
+  "acknowledged": true,
+  "errors": true,
+  "action_results": [
+    {
+      "action": {
+        "type": "remove",
+        "indices": [ "index1" ],
+        "aliases": [ "logs-non-existing" ],
+      },
+      "status": 404,
+      "error": {
+        "type": "aliases_not_found_exception",
+        "reason": "aliases [logs-non-existing] missing",
+        "resource.type": "aliases",
+        "resource.id": "logs-non-existing"
+      }
+    },
+    {
+      "action": {
+        "type": "add",
+        "indices": [ "index2" ],
+        "aliases": [ "logs-non-existing" ],
+      },
+      "status": 200
+    }
+  ]
+}
+--------------------------------------------------
+
+Allowing the action list to succeed partially may not provide the desired result.
+It may be more appropriate to set `must_exist` to `true`, which will cause the entire action
+list to fail if a single action fails.
+
+

generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The newly added `// tag::alias-options[]` ... `// end::alias-options[]` around the `must_exist` description creates a duplicate tag in the same file. The existing `// tag::alias-options[]` before `routing` (visible in the context lines) already uses this tag name. Asciidoc tag extraction tools expect unique tag names per file; having two `alias-options` tags will cause one to shadow the other or produce an error. The new tag for `must_exist` should use a distinct name (e.g., `must-exist-options`) or the existing tag should be renamed.

generatedCommentsNodes.comment: The new getter is named `getActionResults()` while the existing getter on the same class is `actions()` (no `get` prefix). This inconsistent naming convention within the same class is confusing. Consider renaming to `actionResults()` for consistency.

The `ORIGINAL_INDICES` ParseField is declared but never registered in the `ObjectParser` or referenced anywhere in the visible code. The `originalIndices` field is set programmatically via the `indices()`/`index()` builder methods and serialized/deserialized, but it is never parsed from a JSON request body. This appears to be dead code that should be removed to avoid confusion.
